response.goal: Build an n8n workflow that triggers on new responses from two Typeform forms, checks the Google Sheet for an existing row with the same email to skip duplicates, adds a new row with name, email, company, form name and timestamp, posts a message to the sales Slack channel with a link to the row, and emails if any step fails.

plan.step: Kickoff and requirements review to verify Typeform, Google Sheets, and Slack access on the self-hosted n8n instance.
Build the Typeform trigger nodes for both demo request forms and map the incoming response data.
Implement the duplicate check logic by querying the Google Sheet for existing emails before inserting new rows.
Configure the Slack notification node to post formatted messages with row links to the #sales channel.
Add error handling and notification logic to email the team if any step in the workflow fails.

milestones.name: Milestone 1: Workflow Setup & Triggers
milestones.deliverable: Connected Typeform triggers on the self-hosted n8n instance and verified data mapping.

milestones.name: Milestone 2: Logic, Slack Alerts & Error Handling
milestones.deliverable: Functional duplicate check, Google Sheets row creation, Slack channel alerts, and error email notifications.

risks.risk: Budget is specified as an hourly rate ($25-$40/hr) rather than a fixed project total, which may lead to scope creep.
risks.mitigation: Track time strictly against defined milestones and review hours weekly with the client.

risks.risk: Self-hosted n8n instance might have credential or network permission issues connecting to external APIs.
risks.mitigation: Verify webhook and API credentials during the kickoff phase before building the workflow logic.

questions: What email service or SMTP credentials should be used for the failure notification emails?
Are the two Typeform forms structured with identical field names for name, email, and company?
assumptions: The client has admin access to their self-hosted n8n instance and can provide necessary API keys for Typeform, Google Sheets, and Slack.
The Google Sheet has a dedicated column for email addresses to facilitate the duplicate lookup.
